Current internal model (fallible): In view A the system strongly favors the left location (selection 0.99995) which is remembered as a yellow triangle (shape probability triangle 1.0, color yellow 1.0) with high recoverability now/one/two steps (0.846, 0.672, 0.512). Lesser evidence exists for right (red square, selection 0.00005, recoverability 0.328/0.245/0.186), upper (green circle, selection 0.0, recoverability 0.266/0.209/0.164) and lower (blue cross, selection 0.0, recoverability 0.238/0.181/0.141).

In view B the system strongly favors the upper location (selection 0.99873) remembered as a red triangle (red ~0.9995, triangle ~0.9999) with modest recoverability (0.275/0.203/0.156). Other B locations have very low selection probabilities but distinct memories: right yellow cross, lower green circle, left blue square, each with their listed recoverabilities.

If you issue a redirection command, predicted next selections change according to the provided mappings. For example: in A, most commands would move selection to upper/right/lower (probabilities ~0.997–0.999) except a "left" command keeps A-left. In B, an "upper" command keeps B-upper, "right" moves to B-right, "lower" to B-lower, and "left" to B-left with very high probability.
